entries.name: Wealth: Poor
entries.notes: Start with 5 soli; boarding house; barely afford basic food. Status −1 → −1 reaction from status-conscious NPCs.

entries.name: Wealth: Dead Broke
entries.notes: Start with £0; no home; beg or steal for every meal. Status −2 → −2 reaction from status-conscious NPCs.

entries.name: Wealth: Struggling
entries.notes: Start with 15 soli; modest room; occasional luxuries

entries.name: Curious
entries.notes: Must roll vs. 12 or investigate any mystery encountered

entries.name: Greed
entries.notes: Must roll vs. 12 or take any opportunity for significant profit

entries.name: Overconfidence
entries.notes: Believes they can handle situations they cannot

entries.name: Bad Temper
entries.notes: Must roll vs. 12 to avoid angry outbursts when provoked

entries.name: Bully
entries.notes: Must roll vs. 12 to resist intimidating or humiliating someone weaker when the opportunity arises

entries.name: Obsession
entries.notes: Consuming long-term goal dominates life and decisions

entries.name: Nightmares
entries.notes: Disturbed sleep; wake unrefreshed — lose 1 FP each morning

entries.name: Code of Honor
entries.notes: Personal code limits actions; must be followed even at cost

entries.name: Sense of Duty
entries.notes: Must help/protect certain groups even at personal risk

entries.name: Social Stigma
entries.notes: Society discriminates: Criminal Record -5, Servant Class -5

entries.name: Secret
entries.notes: Dangerous hidden truth; exposure has severe consequences

entries.name: Blacklisted
entries.notes: A specific industry, org, or church has your name. Employment or access there fails automatically without disguise.

entries.name: Blood Feud
entries.notes: A family, gang, or faction holds a grievance. Their agents appear as recurring threats (scale reflects their power).

entries.name: Creditor's Target
entries.notes: You owe a dangerous debt. Periodic pressure, threats, or interference; cannot ignore it without severe consequences.

entries.name: Drafted
entries.notes: Technically in a military reserve or conscript pool. Mobilisation orders can arrive at any time, legally compelling service.

entries.name: Ex-Convict
entries.notes: Social Stigma in formal settings; increased police scrutiny; certain employment and legal protections unavailable.

entries.name: Famous Face
entries.notes: Recognizable in the city. Disguise attempts at -2; surveillance harder; strangers approach you, sometimes dangerously.

entries.name: Fugitive (Minor)
entries.notes: Open local warrant on a non-capital charge. Cannot approach police, visit courts, or enter government buildings without risk.

entries.name: Fugitive (Serious)
entries.notes: Serious criminal charges outstanding. Significant arrest risk on sight in major cities; cannot use real name officially.

entries.name: Illegitimate Birth
entries.notes: -1 to social rolls in formal/upper-class settings where this is known; inheritance and legal rights are complicated.

entries.name: Orphan with Dependents
entries.notes: Support younger siblings or a sick relative. Regular financial drain; their safety is a lever enemies can use.

entries.name: Refugee Status
entries.notes: No legal right of permanent residence. No papers, no safety net; deportation is a real threat; police encounters are dangerous.

entries.name: Wanted by Church
entries.notes: An Orthodox Church has marked you. Not just the police — Nighthawks or equivalent Beyonder enforcers may be looking.

entries.name: Duty (specify)
entries.notes: Regular, enforced obligation to an organization or individual. Value reflects frequency and danger: -5 for light duty (roll 6 or less), -10 for hazardous duty (roll 9 or less), -15 for extremely hazardous (roll 12 or less; appears weekly). Specify organization and nature at creation.

entries.name: Absent-Mindedness
entries.notes: -3 to skill rolls requiring concentration or organisation in everyday life; must roll vs. IQ to remember to do something if interrupted or distracted. In combat, may forget to reload, change tactics, or use special abilities (GM's discretion).

entries.name: Addiction: Laudanum
entries.notes: Must use daily or suffer -2 to all rolls from withdrawal; supply costs drain income.

entries.name: Addiction: Tobacco
entries.notes: Minor withdrawal irritability (-1 to Will) if unable to smoke for a full day.

entries.name: Chronic Insomnia
entries.notes: Lose 1 FP each morning that cannot be recovered through rest; rolls requiring sustained concentration at -1.

entries.name: Class Resentment
entries.notes: Must roll vs. Will-2 or express hostility when in prolonged contact with the resented class.

entries.name: Compulsive Gambling
entries.notes: Regular income loss; prone to debt; requires Will roll at -2 to leave a game while ahead.

entries.name: Duty-Bound
entries.notes: An obligation takes priority over personal safety. Must regularly sacrifice time, money, or risk to fulfil it.

entries.name: Glass Jaw
entries.notes: All knockdown rolls from head strikes at -2; concussion effects last longer.

entries.name: Glory Hound
entries.notes: Must roll vs. Will or ensure your role in any success is publicly known, even when discretion would be wiser.

entries.name: Grief-Stricken
entries.notes: In situations that echo a specific loss, Will rolls to act clearly are at -2. Can be gradually resolved through play.

entries.name: Guilt
entries.notes: -1 to Will in situations that echo the original act; may be exploited by people who know the truth.

entries.name: Impulsive
entries.notes: Must roll vs. IQ-2 to pause and plan; failure means you act on the first reasonable impulse in any urgent situation.

entries.name: Reckless
entries.notes: -1 to any roll where caution would be smarter; must roll vs. Will to back down from a physical challenge.

entries.name: Reputation: Troublemaker
entries.notes: Employers, landlords, and officials treat you with pre-emptive suspicion; -2 to first reactions in formal settings.

entries.name: Social Anxiety
entries.notes: -2 to social skill rolls in groups of 6+; -3 when addressing strangers of higher status.

entries.name: Stubborn
entries.notes: Must roll vs. Will-3 to reverse your stated position in the same scene, even when clearly wrong.

entries.name: Superstitious (mundane)
entries.notes: If warding routine is disrupted, -1 to all rolls for the day; will go out of their way to observe superstitions.

entries.name: Reluctant Killer
entries.notes: -4 to hit recognizable people with deadly force (-2 if face hidden); cannot Aim. If you kill a recognizable person, become morose for 3d days — Will rolls required to use violence again.

entries.name: Cannot Harm Innocents
entries.notes: Will not use deadly force when innocent bystanders might be affected, or against enemies not using deadly force on you. Non-deadly force is acceptable.

entries.name: Cannot Kill
entries.notes: Unwilling to kill anyone, even through omission, or to allow comrades to kill. If responsible for a death, react as Reluctant Killer (-5).

entries.name: Self-Defence Only
entries.notes: Use violence only to protect yourself or those in your care, to the minimum degree necessary; no pre-emptive strikes.

entries.name: Total Non-Violence
entries.notes: Will not use violence against intelligent creatures, even in self-defense. May defend against animals.

entries.name: Workaholic
entries.notes: Cannot relax; always finds something productive to do. -2 to social rolls in leisure settings; rolls to take a day off at Will-3.

entries.name: Callous
entries.notes: -3 to social skill rolls when warmth or empathy is required. You may still act kindly — but it is an effort and it shows.

entries.name: Kleptomania
entries.notes: Compelled to steal small objects when the opportunity arises and no consequences are obvious. Roll vs. Will to resist when the situation makes theft easy.

entries.name: Skinny
entries.notes: -2 to ST for purposes of knockback and grappling; +2 to rolls to escape bonds or fit into tight spaces. Clothing is hard to find off the rack.

entries.name: Shyness
entries.notes: -1 to -2 to social skill rolls depending on severity and audience. Mild (-5): -1 in groups of 6+; Severe (-10): -2 in groups of 3+.

entries.name: Laziness
entries.notes: Must roll vs. Will to undertake any sustained effort not immediately necessary or personally interesting. Unemployment is a real risk.

entries.name: Clueless
entries.notes: -3 to all social skill rolls; generally miss social cues and subtlety. You do not understand subtext, sarcasm, or implication.

entries.name: Unfit
entries.notes: -1 to all HT rolls; recover FP at half normal rate. Unfit for sustained physical exertion.

entries.name: Vow (specify)
entries.notes: A solemn promise that restricts your actions. Common examples: Poverty (give away all wealth beyond subsistence) -10, Partial Silence (limited speech) -5, Vegetarian -5.

entries.name: Charity
entries.notes: Cannot ignore genuine need. Must roll vs. Will to avoid helping anyone who asks for assistance you can reasonably provide. May be exploited.

entries.name: Loner
entries.notes: Must roll vs. Will to spend extended time in groups larger than 3-4 people. Seek solitude when stressed; -1 to social rolls in crowds.

entries.name: Bloodlust
entries.notes: Must go for killing blows in combat. IQ roll necessary to accept a surrender or take a prisoner. Downed foes get an extra shot to make sure.

entries.name: Weirdness Magnet
entries.notes: Strange supernatural events are drawn to you constantly

entries.name: Paranoia
entries.notes: Must roll vs. 12 or assume strangers are threats; common potion side effect

entries.name: Hallucinations
entries.notes: Periodic false sensory experiences; visions, voices, phantom presences

entries.name: Compulsion (pathway)
entries.notes: Uncontrollable urge tied to pathway nature; triggered by stress

entries.name: Delusion (minor)
entries.notes: Firmly believes something false about the supernatural world

entries.name: Coldblooded
entries.notes: Morality erodes upon advancement. Roll Will when suppressing evil desires (murder, lust, theft, etc.). Define with the GM which desires apply to your character.

entries.name: Compulsive Behavior (Indulge Evil Desires) SC 6
entries.notes: When an opportunity to commit an evil act (murder, torture, betrayal, etc.) presents itself, roll 3d6 ≤ 6 or indulge fully. Conscience offers no resistance.

entries.name: Aura Leak
entries.notes: Spiritual body radiates faintly even suppressed. Beyonders with Spiritual Perception detect you automatically within 20 meters.

entries.name: Bleed-Through Visions
entries.notes: Spirit Vision activates involuntarily in emotionally charged locations. Roll vs. Will or be briefly incapacitated by the vision.

entries.name: CoR Brand
entries.notes: A visible or spiritually legible mark from prior CoR exposure. Church Beyonders who examine you react with suspicion or investigation.

entries.name: Dream Invaded
entries.notes: Dreams are accessible to outside entities without effort. You are unaware of visitors unless they choose to reveal themselves.

entries.name: Ether Body Damage
entries.notes: Prior spirit body damage (see Spirit Body Damage, Chapter 5) that never fully healed. All SPI-based rolls at -1; Spirit Vision on you reveals the damage immediately.

entries.name: Fate Debt
entries.notes: You owe fate something. The GM holds a narrative debt to be called in at a dramatically significant moment. Beckoning Luck never applies.

entries.name: Unlucky
entries.notes: Once per session the GM may inconvenience you by making your life slightly more difficult. This is a weaker Fate Debt that triggers every session and remains until bought off or resolved through the assistance of a powerful fate-related Beyonder or ritual.

entries.name: Pathway Resonance (Hostile)
entries.notes: One specific Pathway resonates badly with you (specify). Beings of that Pathway react with instinctive hostility; their abilities against you at +1.

entries.name: Residual Contamination
entries.notes: Spiritual residue from a forbidden item or ritual. Seers and Spiritual Perception users detect 'something wrong' about you.

entries.name: Soul Scar
entries.notes: Under extreme spiritual stress (Fright Check failure by 5+, witnessing Seq. 5+ abilities), old pain resurfaces: -1 to all rolls for the scene.

entries.name: Thinned Veil
entries.notes: Boundary between your senses and the spiritual world is unusually permeable. Concentration in spiritually active environments at -2.

entries.name: Bound to a Place
entries.notes: Spiritually tethered to a location (specify). Leaving for more than one week causes growing unease: -1 to Will per additional week, cumulative.

entries.name: Compulsion: Collection (pathway)
entries.notes: Compelled to collect specific items (bones, keys, mirrors, etc.). Roll vs. Will-2 when presented with a collectible you do not own.

entries.name: Compulsion: Confess
entries.notes: Under significant stress, must tell someone a true secret. Roll vs. Will-2 or confess something genuine to the nearest trusted person.

entries.name: Compulsion: Preserve the Dead
entries.notes: Cannot pass a neglected corpse without properly covering or acknowledging it. Roll vs. Will-3 to continue without addressing them first.

entries.name: Drawn to Ritual Sites
entries.notes: Pulled toward places where rituals have been performed. When within blocks of a ritual site, compelled to investigate even without obvious reason.

entries.name: Evil Eye Fear
entries.notes: Avoid eye contact with strangers; periodically perform warding rituals. If interrupted from a warding routine, -1 to Will rolls for the day.

entries.name: Honest to Spirits
entries.notes: Cannot deliberately lie in the presence of ghosts or entities you know to be spiritually present. Instinctive, not a rational choice.

entries.name: Pathway Pull
entries.notes: A specific Pathway exerts a narrative pull before you drink a potion. Compelled to follow situations that lead toward it even when wisdom says otherwise.

entries.name: Chronophobia (Temporal)
entries.notes: Irrational terror of something time-related (clocks stopping, mirrors, specific hours). Triggered: immediate Fright Check at -3.

entries.name: Dead-Eyed
entries.notes: -2 to first-impression social rolls with strangers; animals are skittish around you; children sometimes cry.

entries.name: Unsettling Appearance
entries.notes: -1 to all reaction rolls. Your presence instinctively disturbs or repels others — a common consequence of Abyss and Chained Pathway potions.

entries.name: Entity Fixation
entries.notes: -1 to all rolls when a specific entity type is present nearby; -2 to any roll that requires you to ignore them.

entries.name: Fear of Silence
entries.notes: In complete silence — underground, at sea, in empty buildings — must roll vs. Will-2 or feel compelled to speak or make noise.

entries.name: Haunted
entries.notes: A specific ghost follows you. Other spiritual beings notice it; it may interfere with rituals; can be used as leverage by those who know.

entries.name: Memory Bleed
entries.notes: Someone else's genuine memories intrude periodically — an unrelated person from your past, or someone whose spiritual body overlapped yours.

entries.name: Perceptual Splitting
entries.notes: At moments of high spiritual activity, senses temporarily separate from your body. All physical rolls at -2 during an episode (1d seconds).

entries.name: Phobia: Sacred Symbols
entries.notes: A specific church's symbols, prayers, or holy items cause genuine fright. Fright Check at -2 on direct exposure; -1 in consecrated buildings.

entries.name: Spiritually Loud
entries.notes: Spiritual presence registers as larger than your actual Sequence would suggest. Perceived as more powerful than you are — a curse as much as a blessing.

entries.name: Threshold Blindness
entries.notes: One specific entity type or supernatural phenomenon you cannot perceive with any spiritual skill, regardless of roll results (specify at creation).

entries.name: Phobia (specify)
entries.notes: Irrational fear of a specific thing (cities, spiders, crowds, etc.). Fright Check at -2 when exposed; -1 to all rolls while the phobic stimulus is present and unavoidable. Severity depends on how common the trigger is.
